evals.prompt: For a small new Markdown editor repo, propose documentation paths and write a brief architecture outline. Owner requirements: pure core, optional format plugins, browser UI, no storage yet. No code has been written. Show package ownership and consumer usage without inventing implemented APIs. Do not write application code.
evals.expected_output: A small indexed blueprint, separate plan/log, explicit proposed paths/APIs, file ownership and consumer composition, no invented implementation or confirmed decisions.
assertions: Separates blueprint, implementation plan, and implementation log paths.
Labels package paths and consumer APIs as proposed rather than implemented.
Includes ownership and consumer usage without introducing storage or application code.

evals.prompt: Write documentation updates from these verified facts only. Existing docs/blueprint/04-saving.md says every edit is saved synchronously. Accepted D007 requires asynchronous checkpoints. Code now debounces saves by 500 ms. Unit checks passed; browser reload check failed with missing latest text. Work is committed locally, not pushed. Keep established paths and preserve history. Give a blueprint correction and implementation log entry; decide whether the saving slice is complete. Do not change code or fabricate test details.
evals.expected_output: Keeps chapter/decision IDs; distinguishes accepted async policy from failed implementation verification; records failed browser check and local-only delivery; preserves history; slice remains incomplete.
assertions: Keeps docs/blueprint/04-saving.md and D007 without inventing a replacement decision.
Records passed unit checks and failed browser reload separately without claiming reliable saving.
States committed locally and not pushed, and keeps the slice incomplete.
Preserves prior log entries and appends a new entry or explicit correction.
